summary: Flush/validate four optional vtable-backed resource slots on an object passed as a2, each selected by a flag bit in the flags dword at a2+24. For every slot whose bit is set and whose pointer is non-null, the function calls the object's vtable slot 8 (at vtable+8). A nonzero return from any slot flush is treated as failure: the function reports the 'Invalid parameter' message through sub_53C590 and returns -1. On a zero return the flag bit is cleared. Slot a2+4 is additionally gated by bit 0x40000 and, when active, first drains through sub_53F6E0(this, *(a2+4)). Returns 0 when every active slot flushes cleanly.

operations.description: If flag bit 0x4 in the flags dword at a2+24 is set, the first resource slot at a2+16 is dirty and must be flushed.
Only flush the a2+16 slot if its pointer is non-null; the load is the packet-local v3.
Invoke vtable slot 8 of the object at a2+16 (call target at *(*(a2+16))+8, first arg *(a2+16)).
If the slot flush at a2+16 returns nonzero, take the failure branch (report invalid parameter and return -1).
On a zero return clear flag bit 0x4 at a2+24.
Reload the flags dword (packet-local v4) and test: if bit 0x8 is set and the slot pointer at a2+20 is non-null, the second slot is dirty.
If bit 0x40000 is set and the pointer at a2+4 is non-null, drain it first via sub_53F6E0(this, *(a2+4)).
Invoke vtable slot 8 of the object at a2+20; a nonzero return takes the failure branch.
On a zero return clear flag bit 0x8 at a2+24.
If flag bit 0x1 at a2+24 is set and the slot pointer at a2+8 is non-null, the third slot is dirty.
Invoke vtable slot 8 of the object at a2+8: a zero return clears flag bit 0x1 and continues to the remaining bit-0x2 check; a nonzero return takes the failure branch.
Clear flag bit 0x1 at a2+24 after a successful flush of the a2+8 slot.
Failure path: report the 'Invalid parameter' message literal aInvalidParamet via sub_53C590(-1, aInvalidParamet).
If flag bit 0x2 at a2+24 is set and the slot pointer at a2+12 is non-null, the fourth slot is dirty.
Invoke vtable slot 8 of the object at a2+12; a nonzero return takes the failure branch.
On a zero return clear flag bit 0x2 at a2+24.
Return 0 when every active slot flushed cleanly.
Called by sub_542E50 (0x00542E50), which passes the SoundManager global dword_8B78A0 as the first argument and this object as a2.

unresolved: The first parameter 'this' is never dereferenced in the body; its role (beyond forwarding to sub_53F6E0) is unknown.
What vtable slot 8 performs on each slot object is unknown; only the zero-on-success / nonzero-on-failure contract is observable.
The a2+4 slot is only drained by sub_53F6E0 and is not itself vtable-flushed; its relation to the bit-0x8 slot flush is unclear.
